newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentina's Sancor to issue $50 mln bond due 2001.
newsitem.headline: Argentina's Sancor to issue $50 mln bond due 2001.

text.p: Argentina's dairy company SanCor Cooperativas Unidas Limitada said Monday it will issue $50 million in bonds due November 7, 2001.
The bond will be issued on November 7 and will carry an 11 percent coupon. The issue price will be 99.587.
Coupon payments will be made every six months, with the first payment due on May 7, 1997.
The issue is part of Sancor's $100 million negotiable bond program.
